content.title: 4的倍数之和

resolved.title: 4的倍数之和
resolved.problem_statement_md:
给定的程序，把数组的长度作为第一个输入，创建数组，然后把接下来的输入作为数组的元素。

请完善该程序，遍历数组，计算出数组中4的倍数的数字之和。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Summing Elements in Arrays[/h1] [/s0l0!-header]

You are given a program that takes the length of the array as the first input, creates it, and then takes the next inputs as elements of the array.

Complete the program to go through the array and calculate the sum of the numbers that are multiples of 4.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
5
4
9
16
2
7

[b]Sample Output[/b]
20
[note]To check if a number is a multiple of 4, use the modulo operator % to divide it by 4 and check the remainder.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 要检查一个数字是否是4的倍数，请使用模运算符%来除以4，并检查余数。
